description: This file defines the Imap class within the SuiteCRM namespace, which acts as a wrapper for PHP's built-in imap functions, particularly emphasizing the open() method for connecting to an IMAP mailbox. It includes licensing information, class documentation, and a protected resource property.

classes.name: Imap
classes.description: A wrapper class for IMAP email operations, implementing the ImapInterface.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified IMAP mailbox and stores the resource handle.
